newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Venture touches new high of S$5.80.
newsitem.headline: Venture touches new high of S$5.80.

text.p: Venture Manufacturing Ltd shares soared to a new high of Singapore $5.80 on Friday morning, up about 13 percent, or 65 cents, in active dealings.
The stock, long a favourite with fund managers, saw more than 1.2 million shares traded. Dealers said several blocks were married at between S$5.13 to S$5.20.
Venture, a leading contract manufacturing for the electronics sector, was scheduled to hold a news conference on Friday morning on a new product, the NovaStation Software.
Several broking houses, including Schroder Securities, have a buy recommendation on the stock.
